response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize this kingdom. Make it...futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
(confused)
Futuristic, sire? But we're in the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
(nodding)
Exactly! That's what I want to change. I want to make this kingdom...vaporwave.

JESTER PIPER
(skeptical)
Vaporwave, sire? But that's a...a...a music genre.

KING REGINALD
(excitedly)
Ah, yes! The music! But it's not just the music. I want to incorporate the aesthetic into every aspect of our kingdom. The architecture, the clothing, the food...everything!

JESTER PIPER
(sarcastically)
Oh, wonderful. Because nothing says "medieval" like a kingdom filled with neon lights and distorted VHS tapes.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, Jester, you just don't understand. This is going to be a game-changer.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, including LORD THOMAS, LORD JENKINS, and LORD WILSON. They are all dressed in their finest attire, but with a twist. They are all wearing neon-colored wigs, and their clothes are adorned with distorted VHS tape patterns.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
As you can see, I've already started implementing the new aesthetic. I want every aspect of our kingdom to reflect this...this...vaporwave vibe.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
But, sire, what about tradition? What about honor?

KING REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Tradition, schmadition. We're a modern kingdom now. We need to adapt.

LORD JENKINS
(excitedly)
I love it, sire! I've already started designing new uniforms for the knights. We'll be the most stylish knights in all the land!

LORD WILSON
(sarcastically)
Yes, because nothing says "knightly honor" like a neon-colored tabard.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, Wilson, you just don't get it.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. The buildings are adorned with neon lights, and the streets are filled with people wearing distorted VHS tape patterns. The king, surrounded by his advisors, rides through the streets on a neon-colored horse, waving to the crowds.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
This is it, my friends. This is the future of our kingdom.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
But, sire, what about the peasants? They're not exactly...familiar with this...this...vaporwave aesthetic.

KING REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Don't worry about the peasants, Thomas. They'll come around. They'll learn to love the...the...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. PEASANT'S HUT - DAY

A peasant, PETER, is sitting in his hut, staring at a VHS tape player. He looks confused and disoriented.

PETER
(to himself)
What is this? This is not the kingdom I know.

Suddenly, the VHS tape player starts playing a distorted, slowed-down version of a medieval jousting tournament. Peter looks up, startled.

PETER
(to himself)
What sorcery is this?

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a full-fledged vaporwave utopia. The king, surrounded by his advisors, rides through the streets on a neon-colored horse, waving to the crowds.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
This is it, my friends. This is the future of our kingdom.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
But, sire, what about the...the...medieval tradition?

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, Thomas, you just don't understand. This is the future. And the future is...vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
